sloka: अद्य पर्वतसङ्काशं ससूर्यमिव तोयदम् ।विकीर्णं पश्य समरे सुग्रीवं प्लवगोत्तमम् ।। ६.६३.३८ ।।
transliteration: adya parvatasaṅkāśaṁ sasūryamiva toyadam ।vikīrṇaṁ paśya samare sugrīvaṁ plavagottamam ।। 6.63.38 ।।

translations.english: Now I will wipe the tears of Rakshasas who lost their kin and are bewailing their loss.
